enjoying.

person; a dividing, division.

भजमान (नः-ना-नं)
a. Serving; en-
joying; sharing; right, fit.

भजेन्य (न्यः-न्या-न्यं)
a. Worthy of wor-
ship or reverence.

भाज्य (ज्यं) 1.
n. A portion, a share;
the dividend.
